entries.zh: 拱手侍立等候；让长辈、尊者先过。
entries.en: to wait in attendance with folded hands; to stand aside and let one's elder pass.
entries.notes: L 栏「p̃」为缩写（por?）展开依赖推断，义据 H/M/R 定。

entries.zh: （水流、潮水）停止流动，水流停滞。
entries.en: for a current or tide to stop flowing; still, slack water.
entries.notes: L 栏尾「ma xsio」残缺（mar?），R 栏「tēng lîn : teû」与 M 栏「tēng lāu」不合。

entries.zh: 拦阻、留住（某人），用手段使其停下。
entries.en: to stop or hold back (someone); to check him by some means.
entries.notes: 「尼止」词形罕见，R「nŷ chî」与 M「nī chȳ」略有出入，义依 L 栏。

entries.zh: 阻拦，不让人走；阻滞。
entries.en: to block someone's way; not to let him go.
entries.notes: M 栏第二音节声调污损（T99），R「chò nȳ」与 M「chūi sў」不合。

entries.zh: 久留，停留很久。
entries.en: to linger, to stay a long time.
entries.notes: 中字「向」可疑，末字 M「cū」与 R「gûin」不合，义据 L 栏。

entries.zh: 勉强忍耐；不甘心而忍受驱使。
entries.en: to endure against one's will; to submit resentfully to being used.
entries.notes: L 栏「Detenido engañar」文义残缺，M（lūn ḿ cām sāy）与 R（zìn gū cān zȳ）差异过大，释义存疑。

entries.zh: 拘留，扣押；被留住而不得脱身、不得空闲。
entries.en: to detain, to hold in custody; detained, occupied.
entries.notes: L 栏「detengociu」为讹字（当作 detenido），据 H/M/R 定。

entries.zh: 毅然决意（做某事），坚决。
entries.en: to resolve firmly on something; resolutely, with determination.
entries.notes: M、R 两栏声调均污损（T99），L 栏「firuuuento」即 firmemente。

entries.zh: 决断，决定（做某事）。
entries.en: to decide, to resolve on (something).
entries.notes: M 栏尾「hïã」与 R 栏「guīe」不合，疑为「决下」之讹。

entries.zh: 拿定主意，按自己的判断决定。
entries.en: to settle a matter in one's own mind; to determine according to one's own judgment.

entries.zh: 恳切地决定（去做合宜之事）。
entries.en: to resolve earnestly on what is fitting.
entries.notes: R 栏「guîen」与 M 栏「cûn」不符，义依 H/L 定。

entries.zh: 确实地、坚定地（决定）；确定不移。
entries.en: determinedly, certainly; definite, assured.
entries.notes: L 栏「Determini nada mente」即 determinadamente；R「cō」与 M「cag」不符。

entries.zh: 果敢，果断（决意做某事）。
entries.en: resolute and daring; decisively.

entries.zh: 订立制度、规制；据实裁定。
entries.en: to establish a rule or regulation; to determine in accordance with the truth.
entries.notes: L 栏「a la verdad」与 H 栏「制度」难以密合，M「chī fōi」与 R「chȳ tū」亦不合，释义存疑。

entries.zh: 决意前往，拿定主意要去。
entries.en: resolutely determined to go.
entries.notes: M「chiā cü」与 R「chēng gūi」不合，疑「成去」即「定去」，义依 L 栏。

entries.zh: 拘执、固执，坚持己见而不通融。
entries.en: obstinately attached to something; rigid, dogged.
entries.notes: L 栏「arroja cosa」文义不明（疑讹），义据 H 栏「拘执」。

entries.zh: 坚决而恒久，持之以恒。
entries.en: resolutely and steadfastly; constant, persisting.
entries.notes: 第二字「岫」形义可疑（封存件自注疑「岫/峙」），M「siū」与 R「sīn」不合，释义存疑。

entries.zh: 轻率地决定，思虑粗疏（「拙想」）。
entries.en: to decide rashly, on slight grounds; a crude notion.
entries.notes: M 栏尾「sïo」与 R 栏「sīong」不合，义依 L 栏「de ligero」。

entries.zh: 偏执，一意孤行（坚决要做某事）。
entries.en: obstinately set on doing something; one-sided, bigoted.
entries.notes: M 栏并列两读（piēn chip / giēn chip），R 栏作「chiē」，义依 H/L 定。

entries.zh: 极爱，爱得要死（字形残疑）。
entries.en: to love exceedingly, to be dying for (someone or something).
entries.notes: 第二字字形存疑，M「aÿ lÿ ÿ」与 R「ngāy lī īn」差异大，语义仅据字面推，释义存疑。

entries.zh: 坚执，固执坚持（决意做某事）。
entries.en: to hold firmly to a resolve; stubbornly persistent.
entries.notes: R 栏尾「chiē」与 M 栏入声「chip」不合，义依 H/L 定。
